case.summary: Transaction 3464869 ($599.94, online) on card C03042-K1 was flagged due to an elevated legacy real-time risk score of 0.77. However, the bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model evaluated the transaction at 0.016, reflecting a historical fraud rate of only 0.6%. The purchase originated from device D001825, a clean desktop device with no proxy usage, no ring associations, and zero fraud history. Card C03042-K1 exhibits an established baseline of online purchases in product category R that is consistent with the transaction amount and recent legitimate spending. With no customer dispute and no cross-card links, the transaction is determined to be legitimate and the alert is closed.
